about: Mutant ledger for scripts/compiler-drift (GUARD-2): Go<->Ergo dual-compiler drift gate and fingerprinted IR stop/diff grouping.

mutants.name: compiler-drift-ignores-unmirrored-go-edit
mutants.rule: -check-drift exits 1 whenever a Go compiler rule file changed without a self-hosted compiler/ mirror edit or an active exemption.

mutants.name: compiler-drift-ignores-missing-exemption-reason
mutants.rule: Exemption validation refuses any entry whose reason is empty.

mutants.name: compiler-drift-allows-expired-exemption
mutants.rule: An expired exemption does not satisfy the dual-compiler drift check.

mutants.name: compiler-drift-skips-test-file-exclusion
mutants.rule: Go test files (*_test.go) under internal/sketch/ are excluded from the compiler rule drift gate.

mutants.name: compiler-drift-misses-regression-exit
mutants.rule: -diff-stops -fail-on-regression exits 1 when a new D IR diff appears even if stop counts decreased.

mutants.name: compiler-drift-wrong-stop-count
mutants.rule: Each stop fingerprint counts distinct (file, offset) functions rather than duplicate emission events.
